N01.name: Laurel Marquise Necklace
N01.note: it is held in a woman's open hand in a shop, in front of other necklaces on a maroon velvet board: ignore the hand, the board and every other necklace, and take only the marquise-stone necklace lying across the palm.
N01.lock: A MARQUISE LEAF NECKLACE: one continuous line of clear MARQUISE-cut (navette, pointed oval) faceted stones, each about 5x10mm in its own gold four-claw setting. The stones are grouped in THREES: in every group the three marquise stones are set on a SLANT, side by side and slightly overlapping like three leaves on a stem, all leaning the same way. Each group of three is joined to the next by one small gold link, so the line reads as a row of leaf clusters with a tiny gap between them. Warm polished gold tone settings.
N01.neg: Every stone is a pointed marquise, never round, never pear, never baguette; the stones lie on a slant in groups of three, never in one straight end-to-end row, never in pairs; no pendant, no drop, no plain chain section; clear stones only, no colour.
N01.scale: Each marquise stone is about 10mm long and 5mm wide; the line of stones is about 9mm wide, about half the width of a finger.
N01.wscale: Worn, the line of marquise clusters lies around the base of the neck like a slim sparkling collar, about half a finger wide, never a heavy bib.
N01.place: laid on the top face in a long smooth curve, the slanted clusters of three legible, part of the line running over the cube's front edge
N01.macro: three or four of the slanted marquise clusters in their gold four-claw settings and the small gold links between them
N01.palm: the necklace gathered in the open palm, the line of marquise clusters lying across the palm and over the fingers
N01.pscale: Each marquise stone is about as long as the width of a fingernail; the line of stones is about half a finger wide.

N02.name: Soleil Petal Pendant
N02.note: it is held between a woman's fingers over a black velvet tray, with a white pouch and cards behind it: ignore the hand, the tray and the packaging, and take only the pendant and its fine chain.
N02.lock: A HALF-SUNBURST PETAL PENDANT on a fine gold snake chain: at the top centre ONE round brilliant-cut clear stone, about 7mm, held up in gold claws; FIVE slender polished gold PETALS fan out BELOW and beside it only, like the rays of a rising sun: one points straight left, one down-left, one straight down, one down-right and one straight right, each a narrow open loop of polished gold about 10mm long with a rounded tip. Nothing rises above the stone: the upper half of the pendant is bare and the chain passes behind the stone. The pendant is about 25mm across and about 15mm tall.
N02.neg: Exactly five petals, all in a fan from left round the bottom to right; no petal above the stone, never a full circle of petals, never a pinwheel; the petals are slim open loops, never solid flat leaves, never pave, never sharp star points; one clear stone only; no second pendant.
N02.scale: The pendant is about 25mm across, about the width of a large coin; the centre stone is about 7mm, smaller than a fingernail.
N02.wscale: Worn, the sunburst pendant, about the width of a coin, sits just below the hollow of the throat on the fine chain.
N02.place: laid flat on the top face, the chain in a soft V and the pendant at its point, its five petals fanned below the stone
N02.macro: the round clear stone in its claws at the top and the five polished gold petals fanning out below it
N02.palm: the pendant lying flat in the centre of the open palm, its fine chain trailing over the fingers
N02.pscale: The pendant is about as wide as one and a half fingers; the centre stone is about the size of a fingernail's half.

N03.name: Pearl Crescent Pendant
N03.note: it lies in a white plastic pouch held in a woman's hand: ignore the hand, the pouch and its reflections, and take only the pendant and its chain. The pearl is a smooth round white shell pearl with a soft lustre.
N03.lock: A PEARL CRESCENT PENDANT on a fine gold box chain with a small sliding bead: ONE round white pearl, about 10mm, with a soft creamy lustre, held in a small gold cup; around the lower right side of the pearl curves a slim CRESCENT of about eight small round clear stones, each in its own little gold collar, hugging the pearl like a new moon; the chain runs through a small gold bail at the top.
N03.neg: One pearl only, round and white, never pink, grey or golden; the crescent of small clear stones follows only part of the pearl's edge, never a full halo all the way round; no other drop; the chain is a fine square box chain, never a rope or cable.
N03.scale: The pearl is about 10mm, about the size of a fingernail; each crescent stone is about 2mm.
N03.wscale: Worn, the small pearl with its crescent of stones sits just below the hollow of the throat on the fine box chain.
N03.place: laid on the top face, the chain in a soft V and the pearl crescent pendant at its point
N03.macro: the white pearl and the curve of small clear stones in their gold collars beside it
N03.palm: the pendant lying in the centre of the open palm, its fine box chain trailing over the fingers
N03.pscale: The pearl is about the size of a fingernail.

N04.name: Molten Solitaire Pendant
N04.note: it lies in a white plastic pouch on a black tray, the pouch held by a hand: ignore the hand, the pouch, the tray and the cards, and take only the pendant and its chain.
N04.lock: A MOLTEN SOLITAIRE PENDANT on a fine gold cable chain: ONE round brilliant-cut clear stone, about 8mm, sunk inside an irregular, organic frame of polished gold that looks like molten gold poured around it, with soft uneven ripples and folds on its rim, the frame about 12mm across; the chain passes through a chunky irregular gold loop at the top.
N04.neg: The frame is irregular, rippled and asymmetric like molten metal, never a neat round bezel, never claws; one clear stone only; no pave; a plain cable chain.
N04.scale: The pendant is about 12mm across, about the size of a fingernail.
N04.wscale: Worn, the molten pendant, about the size of a fingernail, sits just below the hollow of the throat on the fine chain.
N04.place: laid on the top face, the chain in a soft V and the molten pendant at its point
N04.macro: the clear stone sunk in its rippled molten gold frame and the chunky gold loop above it
N04.palm: the pendant lying in the centre of the open palm, its fine chain trailing over the fingers
N04.pscale: The pendant is about the size of a fingernail.

N05.name: Petite Pear Solitaire Necklace
N05.note: it is in a clear pouch on a white card printed with a butterfly, a dashed line, words and a necklace icon, held in a hand: ignore the hand, the pouch, the card and all its printing, and take only the necklace.
N05.lock: A PETITE PEAR SOLITAIRE NECKLACE: ONE clear PEAR-cut faceted stone, about 7x10mm, held in fine gold claws, hanging from a tiny round gold bead bail with its narrow pointed tip at the TOP and its round end at the BOTTOM, on a fine gold cable chain.
N05.neg: One pear stone only, clear, never coloured, never a pearl; it hangs point up; no halo, no pave, no second drop, no bar.
N05.scale: The pear is about 10mm long, about the size of a fingernail.
N05.wscale: Worn, the small clear pear, about the size of a fingernail, hangs just below the hollow of the throat on the fine chain.
N05.place: laid on the top face, the chain in a soft V and the pear at its point
N05.macro: the clear pear-cut stone in its fine gold claws and the tiny gold bead bail above it
N05.palm: the pendant lying in the centre of the open palm, its fine chain trailing over the fingers
N05.pscale: The pear is about the size of a fingernail.

N06.name: Petite Fleur Y Necklace
N06.note: it lies in a white plastic pouch held in a hand: ignore the hand and the pouch, and take only the necklace.
N06.lock: A PETITE FLOWER Y NECKLACE on a fine gold cable chain: at the centre front ONE tiny FLOWER, about 6mm, of five small round clear stones as petals around a tiny gold bead centre, where the chain's two arms meet in a V; from the flower a single fine gold chain drop about 5cm long hangs straight down, ending in a tiny polished gold flower charm.
N06.neg: One tiny flower only, with five clear petals; the drop is one single fine plain chain; no pendant other than the flower and the tiny gold charm at the end of the drop.
N06.scale: The flower is about 6mm, smaller than a fingernail; the drop is about 5cm long.
N06.wscale: Worn, the tiny flower sits at the hollow of the throat and the fine drop runs straight down the breastbone.
N06.place: laid on the top face, the chain's two arms in a soft V meeting at the tiny flower, the fine drop running straight down towards the front edge
N06.macro: the tiny flower of five clear stones around its gold centre, the chain's two arms and the top of the fine drop
N06.palm: the necklace lying in the open palm, the tiny flower in the centre and the fine drop running down over the fingers
N06.pscale: The flower is smaller than a fingernail.

N07.name: Asscher Solitaire Pendant
N07.note: it lies in a white plastic pouch on a black velvet tray: ignore the pouch and the tray, and take only the pendant and its chain.
N07.lock: AN ASSCHER SOLITAIRE PENDANT: ONE clear octagonal step-cut (Asscher-cut) stone, about 9mm, its four corners cut off so its outline is an eight-sided octagon, with deep step facets like a hall of mirrors, held in fine gold claws at its corners; a polished gold bail with a single ridge, on a fine flat gold curb chain.
N07.neg: The stone is an octagonal step cut with clipped corners, never a round brilliant, never a rounded cushion; clear only; no halo; one stone only.
N07.scale: The stone is about 9mm, about the size of a fingernail.
N07.wscale: Worn, the clear octagonal stone, about the size of a fingernail, hangs just below the hollow of the throat on the fine chain.
N07.place: laid on the top face, the chain in a soft V and the stone at its point
N07.macro: the octagonal step-cut stone in its gold claws and the ridged gold bail above it
N07.palm: the pendant lying in the centre of the open palm, its fine chain trailing over the fingers
N07.pscale: The stone is about the size of a fingernail.

N08.name: Cushion Bezel Pendant
N08.note: it lies in a white plastic pouch on a black velvet tray: ignore the pouch and the tray, and take only the pendant and its chain.
N08.lock: A CUSHION BEZEL PENDANT: ONE clear cushion-cut stone, about 6mm, rectangular with softly rounded corners, set in a smooth, thick, polished gold bezel rim about 8mm, hanging from a small round gold loop bail on a fine round gold snake chain.
N08.neg: The stone is enclosed by a full smooth gold rim, never claws; clear only; one stone only; the chain is a fine round snake chain, never cable or box.
N08.scale: The pendant is about 8mm, smaller than a fingernail.
N08.wscale: Worn, the small bezel pendant, smaller than a fingernail, sits just below the hollow of the throat on the fine snake chain.
N08.place: laid on the top face, the chain in a soft V and the pendant at its point
N08.macro: the clear cushion stone in its thick polished gold bezel and the small loop bail above it
N08.palm: the pendant lying in the centre of the open palm, its fine snake chain trailing over the fingers
N08.pscale: The pendant is smaller than a fingernail.

A16.name: Herringbone Teardrop Necklace
A16.note: it lies in a white plastic pouch held in a hand: ignore the hand and the pouch, and take only the necklace.
A16.lock: A HERRINGBONE V TEARDROP NECKLACE: a flat polished gold herringbone chain about 3mm wide that, at the centre front, turns into TWO short smooth polished gold TUBE BARS, each about 15mm long and as wide as the chain, which meet at a point to form a sharp V; from the point of the V hangs ONE clear PEAR-cut faceted stone, about 8x11mm, its narrow tip at the TOP joined to the point of the V, its round end at the BOTTOM, held in fine gold claws.
A16.neg: There are two plain polished tube bars forming a V at the front, never a plain bail on the chain; one pear stone, clear, never a pearl; the herringbone chain is flat and about 3mm wide, never a rope, curb or cable.
A16.scale: The pear is about 11mm long, about the size of a fingernail; each bar of the V is about 15mm long and the chain about 3mm wide.
A16.wscale: Worn, the flat herringbone chain lies smooth on the collarbones, the polished V points down at the centre and the clear teardrop hangs from its point, just below the hollow of the throat.
A16.place: laid on the top face in a smooth V, the two polished bars and the teardrop at the point of the V
A16.macro: the two polished gold bars meeting in a V and the clear pear-cut stone hanging point up from it
A16.palm: the necklace lying in the open palm, the polished V and the teardrop in the centre, the herringbone chain over the fingers
A16.pscale: The teardrop is about the size of a fingernail; the chain is about as wide as a grain of rice.

A12.name: Heart Solitaire Huggies
A12.note: they are in a clear bag on a white card printed STAINLESS STEEL, held in a hand: ignore the hand, the bag, the card and its printing, and take only the pair of earrings.
A12.lock: A PAIR OF HEART DROP HUGGIES: each a PLAIN smooth polished gold hinged hoop, about 15mm across and about 2mm thick, with NO stones on the hoop; from the bottom of each hoop hangs, on a small gold jump ring, ONE clear HEART-cut faceted stone about 6.5mm, set in a smooth closed gold BEZEL rim that follows the heart's outline, point down.
A12.neg: The hoops are plain polished gold with no pave, no stones and no texture; the heart sits in a closed bezel rim, never claws; one heart per earring; clear only.
A12.scale: Each hoop is about 15mm across, about the size of a fingertip; each heart is about 6.5mm, smaller than a fingernail.
A12.wscale: Worn, the plain hoop hugs the earlobe and the small bezel heart hangs just below it.
A12.place: the two earrings standing side by side on the top face, each hoop closed, the heart drops hanging forward
A12.macro: one earring: the plain polished hoop and the bezel-set heart hanging from its jump ring
A12.palm: the pair of earrings lying side by side in the centre of the open palm, hoops closed
A12.pscale: Each hoop is about the size of a fingertip.

A08.name: Bow and Heart Gift Set
A08.note: IMAGE 1 shows the PAIR OF EARRINGS in stock, in a clear bag on a white card printed STAINLESS STEEL (ignore the bag, the card and its printing): it is the authority on the motif's stones.
A08.lock: A SET of one necklace and one pair of matching earrings, all three carrying the SAME motif: a BOW made of TWO clear HEART-cut faceted stones, each about 6mm and framed by a fine rim of tiny pave stones, their points meeting at a small polished gold knot; from the knot hangs, on a small gold link, ONE clear HEART-cut stone framed by a halo of tiny clear pave stones, point down. THE EARRINGS: the motif as a stud, each about 14mm long. THE NECKLACE: the identical motif, about 14mm long, as a pendant hanging by its bow from a fine gold cable chain.
A08.neg: Each bow is two heart-cut stones in pave rims, never a pave ribbon bow, never a metal bow; each drop is one halo heart; the pendant and the earrings carry the identical motif; no plain gold heart anywhere; no other stones.
A08.scale: Each earring and the pendant are about 14mm long, about the size of a fingertip.
A08.wscale: Worn, each earring sits on the lobe like a small sparkling bow with its heart drop, and the matching pendant hangs at the base of the throat.
A08.place: the necklace laid on the top face in a soft V with its bow-and-heart pendant at the point, the two earrings standing just in front of it
A08.eplace: the two earrings standing side by side on the top face, their heart drops hanging forward
A08.macro: one earring: the bow of two claw-set heart stones and the halo heart drop below it
A08.nmacro: the necklace's pendant: the bow of two pave-rimmed heart stones, its gold knot and the halo heart drop, hanging from the fine cable chain
A08.detname: IMAGE 2 is the supplier's photograph of the COMPLETE SET in its box: one necklace whose pendant carries the SAME bow-and-heart motif as each earring, and the pair of earrings; copy its arrangement (pendant and earrings matching), but take the construction of the bow from IMAGE 1. Ignore the box, the black insert and the hand.
A08.palm: the necklace and the two earrings lying together in the centre of the open palm, the pendant and the earrings side by side
A08.pscale: Each earring and the pendant are about the size of a fingertip.

N09.name: Petite Heart Trio Necklace
N09.note: it lies on a white plastic pouch: ignore the pouch, and take only the necklace.
N09.lock: A PETITE HEART TRIO NECKLACE: a fine gold cable chain with, at the centre front, a small horizontal pair: ONE polished puffed GOLD heart, about 7mm, with no stones, and beside it a tiny cluster of THREE small round clear stones, about 2.5mm each, in gold claws, set in a little triangle; the chain is attached at the two outer ends of the pair, so the heart and the stones sit side by side along the chain, never hanging below it.
N09.neg: The heart is plain polished gold with no stones, never a stone heart, never a halo; exactly three small clear stones; nothing hangs below the chain; no bow.
N09.scale: The gold heart is about 7mm and the three stones about 2.5mm each, together about 13mm wide, smaller than a fingertip.
N09.wscale: Worn, the tiny gold heart and its three stones sit at the base of the throat on the fine chain.
N09.place: laid on the top face in a soft V, the gold heart and its three stones at the point of the V
N09.macro: the polished puffed gold heart and the triangle of three small claw-set stones beside it on the fine cable chain
N09.palm: the necklace lying in the open palm, the gold heart and its three stones in the centre, the fine chain trailing over the fingers
N09.pscale: The gold heart is smaller than a fingernail.
